## Educational Disclaimer

**IMPORTANT NOTICE:** CloudCore Networks is a **fictional company** created solely for educational purposes. This website is used as a teaching tool for information security, systems analysis, and technology courses at various Australian universities.

### Fictional Nature

- **All company information, services, and claims are entirely fictional**
- **All employees, executives, and testimonials are fictitious characters**
- **Any resemblance to real persons, living or dead, or actual companies is purely coincidental**
- **The offices, data centers, and contact information listed do not exist**
- **This is NOT a real cloud services provider**

## Educational Purpose

This simulated corporate website is designed to provide students with:

- A realistic environment for security auditing exercises
- Practice in information security assessment and compliance
- Experience with vulnerability identification
- Understanding of corporate website structures
- Training in professional documentation review

### Course Usage

This site is currently used in:
- ISYS6018 - Information Security Audit and Control
- ISYS2001 - Systems Analysis and Design  
- MGMT5000 - AI Strategy and Implementation

## AI-Generated Content

### Large Language Model Disclosure

Significant portions of this website, including text content, code, and chatbot personalities, were generated with the assistance of:
- **Claude** (Anthropic) - Primary content generation and code development
- **ChatGPT** (OpenAI) - Additional content creation
- **GitHub Copilot** - Code suggestions and completion

### Chatbot Disclaimer

The employee interview chatbots on this site:
- Are powered by AI language models
- May generate unpredictable or incorrect responses
- Do not represent real people or actual company positions
- May occasionally produce inappropriate content despite safeguards
- Should not be relied upon for factual information

**If you encounter inappropriate, offensive, or concerning content from any chatbot, please report it immediately to your course coordinator.**

## Technology Stack

This website demonstrates modern web development practices using:

### Core Technologies
- **[Quarto](https://quarto.org/)** - Open source scientific and technical publishing system
- **[GitHub Pages](https://pages.github.com/)** - Static website hosting
- **HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript** - Frontend technologies
- **[Bootstrap](https://getbootstrap.com/)** - CSS framework (via Quarto)

### Third-Party Services
- **[AnythingLLM](https://anythingllm.com/)** - Chatbot integration platform
- **[Lordicon](https://lordicon.com/)** - Animated icon library

### Hosting & Deployment
- **Static Site Generation** - No server-side processing
- **Client-side Access Control** - JavaScript-based authentication (intentionally weak for educational purposes)
- **Version Control** - Git/GitHub for source management

## Security Notice

### Intentional Vulnerabilities

This website **intentionally contains security vulnerabilities** for educational purposes, including but not limited to:
- Weak client-side authentication
- Exposed credentials in JavaScript
- Information disclosure vulnerabilities
- Insufficient access controls
- Missing security headers

**DO NOT** use any code, patterns, or techniques from this site in production applications.

### Responsible Disclosure

While vulnerabilities are intentional, if you discover a security issue that could:
- Compromise the GitHub repository
- Affect other GitHub Pages sites
- Impact the hosting infrastructure

Please responsibly disclose it to: [course coordinator email]

## Privacy & Data Collection

### What We Collect
- **No personal data is intentionally collected**
- **No cookies are used for tracking**
- **No analytics services are implemented**

### What GitHub May Collect
As this site is hosted on GitHub Pages, GitHub may collect:
- Basic visitor analytics
- IP addresses for security
- Standard web server logs

Refer to [GitHub's Privacy Policy](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-privacy-statement) for details.
